The main takeaway from our work is that

depth wise separable convolution is a simple and effective technique that can be composed into more complex network architectures to achieve higher accuracy with a modest increase in computational cost.

depth wise separable convolution is an important technique that can be used in many applications to achieve good accuracy while significantly reducing the latency and the number of multiply accumulates (MACs) required for inference.

depth wise separable convolution is an effective technique to build efficient models and the global hyper parameters we introduced can be used as building blocks for building efficient models for a wide range of use cases.
